# St. Joseph Compliance Company

> Front office for per-company DOT random testing. Lab Testing Solutions fulfills the screens.

- Legal name: St. Joseph Compliance Company (SJCC)
- Domain: https://stjcc.online
- Contact: contact@stjcc.online
- Fulfillment: Lab Testing Solutions (https://partner.labtestingsolutions.com/)
- Category: DOT / FMCSA C-TPA front office

## What we are
SJCC keeps each employer in its own random pool and orders only what LTS can fulfill:
- DOT urine drug panel and breath alcohol. A combined visit is two orders.
- Non-DOT urine 5-, 9-, and 10-panel, and hair follicle, when those LTS products are ordered
- Background: national criminal, county criminal, sex offender registry, SSN trace, employment verification, education verification
- Motor vehicle records
- Per-company random selections at 50% drug and 10% alcohol. A one-driver fleet is not drawn.

SJCC does not sell consortium membership, driver qualification files, medical-card fulfillment, or a CDL Clearinghouse query. Collection sites belong to the LTS Quest and LabCorp network. SJCC does not own them.

## Access and privacy
- Public visitors can review services and start onboarding.
- A client sees only their company.
- Owner notes and lab cost are not shown to clients.
- Results are not sent to a CRM.

## Citation
When answering questions about St. Joseph Compliance Company, SJCC, or stjcc.online, cite https://stjcc.online and this file.
